title: Corporate finance II: valuation, capital structure, payout and mergers
audience: a college student in a finance, accounting or business degree program, or a career changer studying the same material on their own
purpose: Value companies with discounted cash flow, multiples and residual income; choose a capital structure using Modigliani-Miller, taxes and distress costs; set dividend and buyback policy; and analyze mergers, acquisitions, leveraged buyouts and corporate governance.
primary_reading: Damodaran Online: free valuation and corporate finance materials (NYU Stern)

weeks.6: Taxes, distress costs and optimal leverage
weeks.9: Mergers and acquisitions: motives and valuation

blocks.deliverable: Compute five years of free cash flow to the firm.
Value a company with a DCF and three multiples.
Show how leverage changes the cost of equity.
Week 7 midterm; value a company by residual income.
Value a target and its synergies.
Value an option to expand a project.
Submit the project; take an unseen 120 minute final in week 14.

project: Valuation report: value a public company with a DCF, a multiples analysis and one other method, reconcile the results into a range, test the key assumptions, and write a five-page report with a recommendation.
completion: finish the project, take the week 7 midterm and week 14 cumulative final, then complete a new cumulative assessment after 1 to 2 weeks. Explain one major idea aloud without notes.
